title: sscanf

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is registered for this compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered to host memory before evaluation.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: [A, count, errmsg, nextindex] = sscanf(text, format, size) - Parse formatted values from text.

signatures.label: [A, count, errmsg, nextindex] = sscanf(text, format, size)

behaviors: Supports repeated literal/whitespace-aware scan formats for %f/%e/%g, %d/%i/%u, %s, %c, field widths, assignment suppression, optional size truncation, and requested outputs for count, errmsg, and nextindex.
String and character scan specifiers return character code values in the numeric output array.
examples: [A,count,errmsg,nextindex] = sscanf("1 2 x", "%f") returns A = [1;2], count = 2, errmsg = "", nextindex at the first unconsumed character after the successful scan.
